learnings: ROOT CAUSE: GroupSyncWrite (broadcast 0xFE, INST_SYNC_WRITE 0x83) does NOT move STS3215 servos. Individual write2ByteTxOnly per motor DOES work. Replaced GSW with per-joint writes in teleop loop.
SCServo SDK port.is_using flag can get stuck True after read exceptions, blocking all subsequent txPacket calls with COMM_PORT_BUSY. Added ph.is_using=False reset before writes.

Lock contention was blocking HTTP: entire poll loop (12 reads + 12 writes) held state_lock for 50-100ms. Restructured: reads inside lock, writes outside lock. HTTP latency dropped from 5s timeout to 10ms during teleop.
Teleop confirmed working at 17Hz with individual writes. All joints track within 2-25 counts error.
Automated diagnostic script built (scripts/diagnostic.py): tests server, boards, temps, calibration, per-joint movement, HTTP latency, teleop start/stop. Results: 25/28 pass.
Diagnostic failures: elbow_flex on desk (pos=74), wrist_flex near cal boundary, gripper backlash (88 count error).
Position logger confirmed working at 2Hz during teleop (previously timed out due to lock contention).
Permissions updated in settings.local.json: all tools auto-approved.
clearPort() in SCServo SDK only flushes OUTPUT buffer (ser.flush), NOT input. Added ser.reset_input_buffer() before writes to clear stale RX data.

learnings: Leader STS3215 servos are 7.4V variants with lighter gearing (1/147 vs 1/345). Position mode stalls at load=800 but cannot overcome gear friction.

THREE register locks prevented ANY leader movement: Max_Torque_Limit(addr 16)=0 (EEPROM), Unloading_Cond(addr 19)=1 (auto-disables torque on any load), Overload_Torque(addr 36)=0 (triggers overload at 0% threshold). All three must be fixed.

Wheel mode (Operating_Mode=1) DOES produce physical movement on leader — gripper went 1848->2383 (535 counts). Position mode with all fixes produces load and slight drift but not reliable controlled movement.

Correct register addresses (from lerobot tables.py): Max_Torque_Limit=16(2B), Unloading_Cond=19(1B), P_Coeff=21(1B), D_Coeff=22(1B), Protective_Torque=34(1B), Protection_Time=35(1B), Overload_Torque=36(1B), Lock=55(1B). Previous code had P_GAIN_ADDR=29 which is wrong.
EEPROM writes require: torque off, Lock(55)=0, write, Lock(55)=1.
Added leader PID temp-set code to ui/app.py move endpoint but INCOMPLETE — sets PID but does NOT fix Max_Torque_Limit or protection registers.

scripts/test_leader_move.py: wheel mode + software position control via velocity commands. Working config: Unloading_Cond=0, Overload_Torque=80, Protective_Torque=20, Protection_Time=8, Max_Torque_Limit=1000.
